summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for a laparoscopic cholecystectomy following a recent ERCP for common bile duct stone removal. The surgery was performed successfully on 2174-09-29. Postoperatively, he experienced right shoulder pain, prompting an orthopedic consultation and joint aspiration, which ruled out recurrent septic arthritis. He also developed transient urinary retention requiring catheterization and was started on tamsulosin, after which he successfully voided with a low post-void residual. His pain was managed with a multimodal regimen, and his liver function tests improved during the stay. He was discharged home on 2174-10-02 in good condition with updated medications and follow-up instructions.
